## Authentication
Authenticate every request using your production API key in the Authorization header.
`Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_your_key`
Generate and manage your key in the Dashboard. Keys are server-side credentials and must never be exposed in client-side code.

title: iPayX MCP Server — Documentation
snippet:
## 3. Authentication
- **Method:** HTTP Bearer token in `Authorization` header.
- **Format:** `ipx_live_xxxxx` (production) or `ipx_test_xxxxx` (sandbox).
- **How to get a key:** [Open your iPayX dashboard → API keys](/dashboard).
```
Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json, text/event-stream
```

title: API Terms of Service – iPayX Protocol
snippet:
Subject to these Terms and timely payment of fees, iPayX grants the API Client a non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to access the API solely for the API Client's internal business purposes and for providing audit results to its own end customers.

Subscription fees and per-audit overage charges are billed monthly via Stripe and follow the published pricing tiers (Starter, Growth, Enterprise). Overage usage beyond the included monthly quota is billed at the per-audit rate disclosed at time of subscription. Fees are non-refundable except as required by law.

title: Integrations — iPayX Protocol
snippet:
# Connect transaction data to iPayX.
Bank sync available in the US and Canada via Plaid. CSV/PDF audit available globally. More corridors and regions planned.
## Supported sources
PlaidAvailableUS & Canada
Read-only bank connectivity via Plaid. Automatic FX transaction extraction from North American bank accounts.
Manual uploadAvailableGlobal
Import transactions via CSV or PDF. The OCR engine automatically extracts and normalizes FX data.
API ingestionAvailableGlobal
Send transactions directly via REST API. Ideal for ERP, treasury, and platform integrations.
